newsitem.title: UK: Facia creditors to get 10 pct of money owed - report.
newsitem.headline: Facia creditors to get 10 pct of money owed - report.

text.p: Unsecured creditors of the collapsed British retail group Facia are to receive about 10 percent of the money owed to them, the Times newspaper reported on Monday.
Privately-owned Facia, whose retail chain included Sock Shop and Saxone, collapsed in June.

The report, which did not cite sources, said Facia's receivers had raised around 20 million stg from selling parts of the business. It said some 8.5 million stg would go to bankers, with another 5 million stg going to preferential creditors including former employees and the UK tax authorities.
The Times said the remainder would be paid to unsecured creditors, who together were owed 50 million stg. The largest of these is the retail group Sears Plc which lodged a claim for 30 million stg.
